recipes.name: Chicken Meatball Hotpot inspired By Jujutsu Kaisen
ingredients: 1 leek, cut into half inch rounds
2 to 3 large carrots, sliced on a bias
1 bunch chrysanthemum leaves (or other greens like spinach)
instructions: For Hotpot:
For the Donabe
Wash about 2 cups of rice and save the starchy water. - 2 cups rice - water for washing
Pour the starchy water into your Donabe until it's 80% full.
Bring the water to a boil, letting it simmer to seal the porous surface of the pot.
Rinse the pot and wipe it dry. The Donabe is now ready to use.
For the Chicken Meatballs
Chop the chicken thighs into chunks, and finely chop the green onions. - 6 boneless skinless chicken thighs - 4 green onions finely chopped
Grate 1 tsp of ginger - 1 tbsp fresh ginger grated
In a food processor, pulse the chicken thighs until finely minced but still slightly chunky. - 6 boneless skinless chicken thighs

Combine the minced chicken with the chopped green onions, grated ginger, and 3 egg yolks in a bowl. - 6 boneless skinless chicken thighs - 4 green onions finely chopped - 1 tbsp fresh ginger grated - 3 egg yolks
Season with salt and pepper. Mix the ingredients by hand until well combined. - Salt and pepper to taste
Place the meatball mixture in the fridge to chill while you prepare the vegetables and broth.
Once chilled, use two spoons to scoop and shape the chicken mixture into small meatballs, about 9 cm in diameter.
For the Hotpot Vegetables

Cut the leek into half-inch thick rounds. Peel and slice the carrots at a diagonal. Slice the king oyster mushrooms in half. Rinse and set aside the chrysanthemum leaves. - 1 leek cut into half inch rounds - 2 to 3 large carrots sliced on a bias - 4 to 5 king oyster mushrooms halved - 1 bunch chrysanthemum leaves (or other greens like spinach)
For the Broth
In your Donabe, add water and kombu. - 6 cups water - 1 large piece kombu (dried kelp)
Bring the water to a simmer, then remove the kombu.
Add soy sauce, mirin, and sake to broth. - 2 tbsp soy sauce - 2 tbsp mirin - 3 tbsp sake
Bring the broth to a gentle boil.
For the Assembly and Cooking
Gently lower shaped meatballs into the simmering broth. Work in batches if necessary. - For the Donabe - For the Chicken Meatballs
Cook the meatballs for about 5 minutes, or until they are firm and cooked through.
Once all the meatballs are cooked, return them to the broth.
Arrange the prepared vegetables around the meatballs in the Donabe. - For the Donabe - For the Chicken Meatballs - For the Hot Pot Vegetables
Cover the pot with a lid and bring everything to a simmer. Cook for 3-4 minutes until the vegetables are tender.
Turn off the heat and serve the hotpot straight from the Donabe.
For Ramen in Hotpot Broth:
After eating the hot pot, use the leftover broth to cook the ramen noodles. - leftover hotpot broth
Bring the broth back to a boil, then add the ramen noodles and cook according to package instructions, about 2-3 minutes. - ramen noodles package
Crack in 2 eggs and poach them gently in the broth without breaking the yolks. - 2 large eggs
Once the eggs are cooked, top the ramen with chopped scallions. - scallions chopped
